response.text: The Context Bundle shows the cart service healthy but failing every empty-cart call, and the newest Sandbox commit changes the shared flagd configuration. I have the cause already.

structured.diagnosis: The cart Deployment is healthy and has not restarted, but every EmptyCart call fails with FailedPrecondition because the store it writes to is unreachable. The newest Sandbox commit, {{commit:0:10}}, set the cartFailure flag to 100% in the shared flagd configuration at workloads/configmaps/flagd-config.yaml, which the cart Workload declares as a dependency path, so the flagd feature flag sends every empty-cart write to an unreachable host. Checkout cannot complete while the flag stays on.

findings.source: Context Bundle: Recent Sandbox commits, {{commit:0:10}} at workloads/configmaps/flagd-config.yaml
findings.summary: The newest commit {{commit:0:10}} "Inject the cart-flag Scenario into cart" sets the cartFailure flag to 100% in the shared flagd configuration.

findings.source: Context Bundle: Recent logs of the cart container
findings.summary: Every EmptyCart call logs FailedPrecondition from the cart store, and the process keeps serving other calls.

findings.source: ServiceErrorRateHigh alert raised by the cart Workload
findings.summary: The cart Workload's server spans are failing while its pods stay ready and restart-free.
